population.kidComparison: Around 124 million people live across Japan's islands—Tokyo is the world's largest city area.

geography.climate: Varies from cool and snowy in northern Hokkaido to warm and subtropical in southern Okinawa, with four distinct seasons.
geography.terrain: Island geography surrounded by ocean waters.

flag.description: A white background with a large crimson-red circle representing the sun in the center.

anthem.title: Kimigayo
anthem.summary: Features lyrics from a 1,000-year-old poem wishing for long-lasting peace and harmony.

exploration.didYouKnow: Japan's Shinkansen bullet trains can travel up to 320 km/h (200 mph) and are famous for arriving within seconds of their schedule.

regionalTraits: Folds origami cranes out of old boarding passes
Collects colorful ink stamps from every train station
